newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Feedgrain buys 52,500T of Argentine corn.
newsitem.headline: Korea Feedgrain buys 52,500T of Argentine corn.

text.p: The Korea Feedgrain Purchase Committee (KFPC) on Wednesday bought 52,500 tonnes of Argentine corn in tender at $153.18 per tonne, C&F, traders said.
KFPC was originally seeking 52,000 tonnes of corn, but decided to buy an additional 500 tonnes, they said.
Traders said Toepfer won the contract with shipment for May 21-June 10 from Argentina. Arrival was set for July 15 at the western port of Inchon.

The KFPC was first introduced to the local market on Wednesday as a new buying group. It consists of members of feed mill companies including Shindongbang Corp and Sam Yang Foods Co Ltd, which had bough their corn needs through the Korea Feed Association.
